key_insight: Puppies.co.uk sells trust at platform level (ID-verified breeders, a vetting team that turns half of them away, a five-week health guarantee and a protected deposit) and wins Staffy-plus-town searches with thin, templated town hubs that repeat one breed blurb over a short feed of the same few adverts, most from other towns. BSUK can beat those hubs with city pages built on one breeder's own blue Staffy litters, named health tests, real local detail and a stated price and deposit, while matching the platform's reassurance points in its own words.
